fields.name: imu_header_stamp
fields.vehicle_driver_source: src/sensor_drivers/livox_ros_driver2/src/lddc.cpp:570-603 and :758-780 assign ROS 2 header.stamp from cur_node_->now(); the commented path used pkg/imu hardware timestamps

fields.name: imu_linear_acceleration_scale
fields.super_lio: raw g copied; kf_init computes imu_scale=g_gravity_norm/initial_mean_norm and ESKF::Predict applies it
fields.vehicle_fastlio: original callback multiplies raw g by10.0; original IMUProcessor propagates this input without mean-norm amplitude rescaling
fields.reason: MID360 protocol specifies g; recorded norm about.9957g. Existing paths have different known normalization, not missing unit evidence.
fields.source: original lio_node.cpp:441-449; src/perception/fastlio2/src/map_builder/imu_processor.cpp; pinned Super kf_init/ESKF::Predict; official MID360 protocol
fields.super_lio_source: Super-LIO ROSWrapper.cpp:350-352 copies sensor_msgs/Imu.linear_acceleration directly into IMUData.acc
fields.risk: Nominal acceleration gain/noise models are different; original callback/config remain protected. Functional replay is not universal numerical or physical accuracy equivalence.

fields.name: imu_angular_velocity
fields.risk: Official protocol specifies rad/s and both parsers preserve raw values. Posterior bias/body covariance now software-qualified; physical angular accuracy remains unmeasured.

fields.name: livox_offset_time

fields.vehicle_fastlio: offset_time * 1e-6 stored as ms, then /1000 for cloud end
fields.reason: both use driver arrival-time header; hardware timebase relationship is unverified

fields.vehicle_fastlio: body/world height window and separate obstacle window

fields.name: health
fields.super_lio: measurement-stamped native certificate, actual observation-only six-pose information min eigenvalue and feature count/worst iteration
fields.vehicle_fastlio: degeneracy eigenvalue/condition metric and health aggregator
fields.reason: Under original fixed extrinsics, legacy twelve-block min eigenvalue >=min(lambda_min(Hobs),100000). Test unchanged75/50/current3IMU requirements; this is a stricter sufficient bound, not raw legacy degeneracy identity.
fields.motion_policy: Invalid/missing/expired certificate denies health; RTK loss remains an independent stop even eligible LIO. Physical localization accuracy/target deployment remain pending.
